## Project structure

```text
/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/
├── index.html       # Game markup and UI panels
├── game.js          # Gameplay logic, state, rendering, controls, and saves
├── style.css        # Visual styling, responsive layout, themes, and motion preferences
├── README.md        # Game overview, controls, and play instructions
├── start.sh         # Startup wrapper
├── startup.sh       # Additional startup wrapper
├── capture.sh       # Capture wrapper
├── .github/
├── .agents/
└── .omgithub/
```

## Game and key files

The project is **ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire**, a self-contained browser RPG built with vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a 2D Canvas renderer. It has no `package.json` or external game framework.

- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js) — Combat, 100-floor progression, bosses, leveling and stat allocation, loot, equipment, waystations, quests, residents, rendering, controls, and localStorage persistence.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html) — Canvas arena, combat controls, status and quest panels, tower travel, shop, residents, and language/theme controls.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css) — Layout, visual design, themes, responsive styling, and reduced-motion rules.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md) — Game overview and controls.

## Run and test

Run from the project directory:

```bash
cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open **http://localhost:8000** in a browser. The README also says you can open `index.html` directly.

**Tests:** No test files or repository test command were found. Verify manually in a browser: combat and controls, floor progression and travel, save/load, responsive/touch input, and language/theme settings.
</subagent>
